problem: Exact-main production opened the active v18 mobile drawer successfully but contained zero language selects, so the NL/EN roundtrip could not start.
root_cause: assets/js/i18n.js mounted mobile language controls only into generic data-bg mobile roots and #bgkopMob. The production navigation uses #v18MobileDrawer, which was omitted from mountControl().
prevention: Treat #v18MobileDrawer as a first-class mobile language host in the runtime.
Keep generic mobile hosts and legacy #bgkopMob support for compatibility.
Guard the runtime host list with a regression test tied to the production verifier.
Require exact-main Netlify commit equality plus the visible mobile NL->EN->NL browser roundtrip before LIVE_BEWEZEN.

evaluation.expected_invariant: when #v18MobileDrawer exists, mountControl installs exactly one mobile language control and the production verifier can complete NL->EN->NL
